description: Defines PRACH (Physical Random Access Channel) configuration structures, enums, and functions for 3GPP NR (5G) specifications, including parameters for SSBs per RACH occasion, PRACH configuration, and retrieval functions.

classes.name: prach_configuration
classes.description: Contains parameters for PRACH configuration, including format, SFN period and offset, slots, starting symbol, number of slots, occasions, and duration.

methods.name: ssb_per_rach_occ_to_float
methods.description: Converts an ssb_per_rach_occasions enum value to its float representation.

methods.name: prach_configuration_get
methods.description: Retrieves a PRACH configuration based on frequency range, duplex mode, and configuration index.
